title: security: may an AI service account trigger a flow declared runAs system? (ADR-0151 non-goal, #31739 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPF1skfu2kx89BEXZi

Filing gate: ④ decision node, a follow-up to #31739 (ADR-0151, AI service account). It is not a claim, and it names a question the seat cannot rule on.
Business reason: PR #31867 (#31739 PR-2) holds an AI service account to its explicit grants and never lets it run as the system (ADR-0151 D3). A flow whose author declared `runAs: 'system'` still runs as the system when an account triggers it, because the flow author granted that run to whoever may trigger the flow. ADR-0151's Non-goals list says "a flow or job `runAs` naming an account" is not decided there, and ADR-0073's automation principal stays the identity of user-less runs. Whether the trigger door should refuse an account in front of a system flow is therefore a narrowing beyond the ADR's declaration.
Reader: the maintainer, through the `needs-user-decision` label. The fix lands on server seat 1 if the answer is A.
Dedupe: no open or closed card asks whether a `runAs` system flow may be triggered by an agent account.
class: c · type: Decision
Grade: p2. Nothing is exposed today: no account can be registered before #31739 PR-3, and option B gives the account no power the flow author did not already give every member allowed to trigger the flow.

## 维护者速读

AI 服务账号（ADR-0151）只能用显式授予的权限，永远不以系统身份运行。但如果某个流程的作者把它声明为以系统身份运行（`runAs: 'system'`），账号触发它时，流程照样以系统身份跑。ADR-0151 把这件事明确列为"本记录不决定"。需要你定：是在触发入口拒绝账号（A），还是保持现状、把它当作流程作者的授权（B）。

## Options

- **A. Refuse at the trigger door.** An account that triggers a flow declared `runAs: 'system'` gets a refusal by name. This narrows every automation an account may trigger, so it needs an ADR-0151 amendment (or an O6 decision) and a `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` changeset.
- **B. Keep today's behaviour (seat recommends).** The flow author's `runAs: 'system'` is the grant. The account is the trigger, not the acting identity, and the run now carries `principalKind: 'agent'` on its trigger facts, so O2 and O6 (the ADR's named readers of the kind) can route or hold it later. ADR-0151 gets one sentence in its Non-goals saying so when it is next amended.

## Seat analysis

B is safe and adds no power: a member who may trigger the flow already gets the same system run, and the account's own grants are clamped and refused at assignment by PR #31867. A also leaves a gap, because `runAs` naming a person (not the system) is the same shape and is equally undecided; ruling A alone would split the two. The PR #31867 contract review (issuecomment-6735749732, ③ flag 4a) reads the same. The seat recommends B.
